summary: Test executed the BiliDili cold-start chain on a safe real-source copy through the public Alembic MCP route. plan/init/bootstrap/submit/dimension_complete/status/recipe_map/search all ran. Nine Recipes were persisted in DB, three per dimension; all three dimensions completed and status reports recipeCount=9/dbRecipeCount=9/materializedRecipeCount=0. Evidence gate rejected bad snippets with actionable SNIPPET_MISMATCH. However final acceptance remains blocked: bootstrap still reports projectIdentity.fileCount=4/moduleCount=0 and targets[].fileCount=1 for AOXFoundationKit/AOXNetworkKit despite plan draft seeing 163 files/10 modules and AOXFoundationKit=22/AOXNetworkKit=30. Graph/recipe_map recover after Recipes exist but still identify the project as AOXFoundationKit/project:aoxfoundationkit and target nodes as package.json paths. Host status also reports project_handoff_mismatch. Conclusion: cold-start Recipe production is partially successful, but BiliDili real-project target counting/project identity is not a clean pass.
